gcp-pca-s6.1-06.statement: Google Cloud Managed Service for Prometheus answers a PromQL query from a single Google Cloud region's data.
gcp-pca-s6.1-06.explanation: Google Cloud Managed Service for Prometheus evaluates queries against a global datastore and combines results across regions. Teams obtain a unified view rather than querying isolated regional servers.
gcp-pca-s6.1-06.misconception: Managed Prometheus query evaluation is confined to one regional datastore.

gcp-pca-s2.3-04.statement: Compute Engine's default sole-tenant maintenance policy live-migrates VMs within a fixed server pool.
gcp-pca-s2.3-04.explanation: Compute Engine's Default sole-tenant maintenance policy lets eligible VMs migrate to new physical servers. Migrate within node group confines migration to a fixed server pool.
gcp-pca-s2.3-04.misconception: The default sole-tenant maintenance policy preserves the fixed physical-server pool needed by some licenses.
